evidence: Has the Build system label and updates Guix manifests in contrib/guix/ to restore release builds on RISC-V and Python 3.12.
rationale: Fixes release binary building on RISC-V hardware and resolves Guix build failures under Python 3.12 for the 32.x release branch. The PR description notes that these backports 're-enable building release binaries on RISC-V hardware' and fix broken builds, addressing supported-platform build failures.
